Both pathways demonstrate a clear, albeit indirect, route through which Cabergoline may influence the Alpha-1B receptor. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, likely due to the presence of well-characterized intermediaries (Renin, R450, dapiprazole) that are known to interact with the Alpha-1B receptor. The integration of these pathways supports a mechanistic link between Cabergoline and the Alpha-1B adrenergic receptor, though further validation through direct interaction studies or in vivo experiments would be necessary to confirm the exact mode of action.
